name: Mississauga / North York
description: The former Oakville–Square One–North York through service was shortened at Square One in 2016. Its historical North York branches include Finch and York Mills.

timeline.event: The timetable shows weekday Oakville–Square One–North York buses including Finch-bound service.
The printed table still includes the Oakville extension.
The Square One–Oakville portion was discontinued.

sources.title: GO table 19, printed effective 4 February 2006 (filename dated 13 May 2007)
GO table 19, printed effective 31 December 2011 (filename dated 14 June 2012)
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)

gaps: Individual branch dates and later Transitway stop changes need more contemporary notices.
